utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: I will turn to the Prosecutor and ask him to continue with the witness.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Your Honour, the first thing that I would like to do that I neglected to do at the end of the day yesterday, is to tender the map which would be Prosecutor's Exhibit 223 to which we've been referring.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Mr. Dzuro, at the point where we left off yesterday, we were talking about this trip that you had gone on to Vukovar in February of this year to investigate scenes that were depicted in the videotape. When you were on this visit to Vukovar, did you take any photographs of locations that you visited?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I did.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: At this time, I would like for you to view the first photograph, which I will mark as Prosecutor's Exhibit 224, and if you can explain to us what is depicted in this photograph? I would ask you, Mr. Dzuro, if you could display this on the ELMO, please? Can you explain what is depicted in this photograph, please?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: I photographed this area. This is the spot I depicted on the map as well, which I marked as the location at 15.42. This is the house with the gable facing the road, the tree in front of it, the branches. Also, the electric post, the grass area on the right side of the road, the shed, and then in the background here is this tree with the very specific top (indicated). I will talk about that later.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: I would like for you to view the next photograph which we will mark as Prosecutor's Exhibit 225, and if you can, please identify this photograph? What is shown in this photograph?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: This is the same house which I photographed from the front side, and I took this picture for one particular reason, is the angle of the roof. You can see that the angle of the roof is different than the one on the video. If I can -- can I show the other photograph, the previous one? I can't remember the number.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: It's 224. Yes, if you can.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: You can see, if you take the picture from a different angle towards the building, the shape of the roof is different. So if you go a little bit further down south, the angle will be more steep. The second photograph I took from here (indicated) looking directly toward -- to facing the building, so the angle of the roof, see, is not so steep.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Now I would like for you to look at the next photograph which we will mark as Prosecutor Exhibit 226. Can you identify this photograph, please?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes. This is the same house, and again I took this picture to show to the court the different angle of the roof if you photographed it from the different location. Again, you can see the tree in front of it is very close to the building and then the boarded window in the upper part of the gable.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: I would like for you now to look at the next photograph which we will mark as Prosecutor's Exhibit 227. Can you explain what is depicted in this photograph, please?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes. This is the grass area on the right side of the road. If you look from that location towards Vukovar -- if I may use the first photograph again?

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Which was 224. Yes, please.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: This is the area right here in front of the shed (indicated). If you look on this photograph and the still I took from the video, it is obvious there is something missing. There is a traffic sign in this area -- there is a traffic sign in this area on the still which is not on this photograph, so I did an investigation into this, and I thoroughly walked in that area around, and I discovered the concrete base with the metal bar which is the same one which is used in that area for the traffic signs. So I took a photograph of that and the exact location where I discovered that, and this is the photograph.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Now I am going to show you the next photograph which we will mark as Prosecutor's Exhibit 228, and if you can indicate what is depicted in this photograph, please?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: So what I did afterwards, I -- I wanted to reconstruct the scene. For that reason, first I took the picture of the scene the way it looked, which is the photograph -- the first one I presented.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Which was marked as Prosecutor's Exhibit 224; correct?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: That's correct. And then I went to the UNTAES and asked for their assistance because I needed to obtain a traffic sign, this traffic sign which shows to the drivers that you are driving on the main road. The UNTAES, they weren't able to provide me with that, but they were happy to assist, so we went to the local police and asked them to provide a traffic sign, but unfortunately, the conditions in Vukovar the way they are, they also were not able to assist us with the traffic sign. So I asked for the police, traffic police car, the patrol car, and we went together back to the scene. What I didn't want to do, I didn't want to remove the traffic sign from the other direction because it could cause some traffic problems, so I asked the Croatian police for their assistance. You can see the car parked here (indicated). What we did, we removed the traffic sign from that side of the road, put it on the metal bar, and then just placed it where it used to be, or it appears it used to be, and this photograph showed the scene now with the electric post, the traffic sign, the white shed, the tree in the background, the building with the gable facing the road, and then the tree with the branches in front of that. If you allow me in my next -- when I will testify about the videotapes, I will explain the reason why the traffic sign is actually here. I wanted to have the traffic sign here. There is a particular reason for that. But if I can explain a little bit later?

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Perhaps that would make more sense, yes. Now, as I understand it, just to make this absolutely clear, this photograph is identical to the one that has been presented as Prosecutor's Exhibit 224 except for the fact that you have attempted to reconstruct what was seen in the videotape by putting the sign back in place; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct. I wouldn't call it identical because I'm not sure I managed to take the same angle because it is very difficult to find the same angle if you do two photographs. But this is the photograph of the same location. The only difference is that on this one, I put the traffic sign back.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Very well. At this time, I would also like to show you Prosecutor's Exhibit 222 which was the video still, I think which depicts somewhat the same view, and if you can indicate, showing that, the similarities between that and what we see in Prosecutor's Exhibit 228?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Are we able to display both photographs at the same time, or it wouldn't fit?

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: I don't know that it is possible. We may lose so much detail in doing that that it's going to be difficult to see. Maybe if you try to cover up the buses, put those underneath, because I don't think those are crucial to what we're talking about. All right. Again, if you can just go through this and point out the items that you found to be similar between the video still and the photograph that you have taken in this reconstruction where you've added the sign?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Electric post here and here, the white shed here and here, so the traffic sign here and here (indicated).

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Do you also see the tree that you talked about earlier?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: The top of the tree here and then it's here (indicated).

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: At this time, I would tender these photographs as Prosecutor's Exhibits 224 through 228.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: May I add something to this, please?

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: I would like -- I mean, if you could focus on this area, on the right side of the road; it is very important for my further testimony as far as Negoslavci is concerned.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: What is the importance or the significance of this area that you've just pointed out?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: You will see, this is flat land, there is no ditch. There are no reinforced bridges anywhere in this area. It's just grass.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Again, at this time, I would tender these exhibits as 224 through 228?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: Mr. Fila, any objection?

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: At some point in time, Mr. Dzuro, did you also take a set of measurements between various locations that you have discussed during this trial?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I did.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Did you record these in your report?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: That's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: At this time, if Your Honours please, if Mr. Dzuro could refer to his report?

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: I would like for you to go through these various measurements with the court and discuss the travel times between the locations you have indicated.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Your Honours, can I use the map as well, please?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: The map is Prosecutor's Exhibit 223. Mr. Dzuro, do you have a copy of your report at hand?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I do.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Very well. If you could proceed and just, perhaps pointing out on the map, explain to the court the measurements that you took?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: The first measurement I made was in between the JNA barracks in Vukovar and the VELEPROMET facility, which I marked also on the map, the JNA barracks. This is the facilities here. There are basically two entrances, one from this side and one from this side (indicated).

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: The one that you've pointed out which you're saying is on this side where the pointer is now, based on the knowledge you have, is that the location where the buses had entered to the barracks on the 20th of November when the men were taken from the hospital?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct. So I measured the distance from the JNA barracks to VELEPROMET, and it's 425 metres, and if you drive a vehicle at a speed of 50 kilometres per hour, you need about 30 seconds to get from one location to the other location.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Mr. Dzuro, if I could ask you, maybe you could slide this over just a little bit so we can see the -- yes, I think that's perhaps a little better -- where you can see the locations you have indicated. What was the next measurement that you took?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Next measurement was in between the VELEPROMET facility and the location depicted at 15.36 (indicated).

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: What was the distance there?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: The distance is about 1.080 metres. You need approximately 80 seconds to drive in a car at a speed of 50 kilometres per hour.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: What next after that?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: The next measurement is in between VELEPROMET and the location depicted at 15.42. This is VELEPROMET again and this is the location at 15.42, and the distance is 715 metres. You need about 50 seconds at the same speed.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Additional measurements that you made?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes. I continued measuring from VELEPROMET to the hangar at Ovcara. I will point on the map the route -- I'm not sure --

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: You can perhaps slide the map up a little bit or maybe the focus can come out a little bit, include more of it? I think that's fine.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: So I will show you again on the map. This is VELEPROMET. Here I go to the turn where the road -- there's an intersection between the field road towards Ovcara and the main Vukovar-Negoslavci road. You drive in the field (indicated). The distance between VELEPROMET and the hangar at Ovcara is 7.800 metres. You need approximately 9 minutes to drive at a speed of 50 kilometres per hour.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Based on your work in this investigation and having talked to survivors from the incident at Ovcara, is this the same route that they were taken on on the 20th of November, to your knowledge?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Did you make any other measurements?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I did. I measured the distance between the location depicted at 15.36 and turned towards Ovcara from the Vukovar-Negoslavci road, which is from here to here, and it's 2.100 metres (indicated). You need approximately 2 minutes of driving again at the same speed, 50 kilometres per hour.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Was that the last measurement that you took?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: No. I made more measurements. The next one was the location depicted at 15.36 and the hangar at Ovcara. Using the same road like previously, up to the turn point, through the fields, this way, and to Ovcara (indicated). The distance is 7.000 metres, needing approximately 8 minutes of driving. The next measurement I did is in between the location depicted at 15.36 and Negoslavci. I have to move the map again a little bit.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: That's fine, I think, if you can --

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: So it's from here, and I measured the distance to the main crossing, it's in the middle of the village, there's a main crossing, this distance (indicated), and it's 5.000 metres, and you need approximately 6 minutes to drive at a speed of 50 kilometres per hour. I continued further, in between this location, 15.36 and Orolik, which, unfortunately, is not on this map, but it goes further down past Negoslavci, continues on this road, and the distance is about 11.000 metres. You need 13 minutes to travel at the same speed.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: So it's 13 minutes from the location depicted at 15.36 to Orolik going at 50 kilometres an hour?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: And then did you continue on past Orolik?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I did. I finished my measurements at Sidski Banovci, so I measured the distance from 15.36, from the location depicted at 15.36, to Sidski Banovci. It's 18.300 metres. You need approximately 22 minutes to drive at a speed of 50 kilometres per hour.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Now, when you were in Vukovar doing this investigation, did you also make several videotapes which showed locations you believe that might be relevant to this investigation?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I did.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: In one of these videotapes, did you film the route from VELEPROMET to the Ovcara hangar?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I did.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: At this time, I would ask that this videotape be shown. Your Honours, the tape takes, all together, approximately 12 minutes, so I'm not sure if you wish to view it in its entirety. We can perhaps fast forward through some of it or scan through it. It's up to you. But we will ...

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: Yes, in its entirety, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Very well. We will mark this as Prosecutor's Exhibit 229, and if this can now be shown?

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Mr. Dzuro, perhaps you can just explain what we're seeing as we view the videotape? (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: I start filming at VELEPROMET, which is on the right side of the road.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: At this point in time, which direction are you travelling?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: I'm travelling south from the centre of Vukovar and the road from the centre of Vukovar towards Negoslavci. (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Freeze it here now, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: If you can stop there?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: A little bit backwards, please. A bit more. Yes, that's okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: You can't use the pointer --

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Unfortunately. On the left side of this road, you can see the shed which I photographed, and it's shown on some of these photographs which I presented in my previous testimony, and on the right side -- this is the traffic sign I had to remove to be able to put it on the other side of the road, and I was also talking about -- I tried to explain what was the legitimacy of this traffic sign to be there. You can see just behind this traffic sign on the right side, there is an intersection, so the traffic sign was on this side of the road going from Vukovar to Negoslavci, and obviously there should be a traffic sign on the other side of the road where I discovered the base, the concrete base, and the bar which was lying on the grass. Somebody removed it for some reason. But there's a legitimate reason for this traffic sign to be there.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: What is the reason for the sign to be there?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: It shows that when the car is driving on the road from Vukovar to Negoslavci or from the Negoslavci to Vukovar, it's on the main road. It means that the car coming from the side road has to give way.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: If the tape can continue now, please? (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Can you freeze it, please, here? So the building which is on the right side now -- unfortunately, the sun was against the camera so it's not so good to see -- but the building on the right side is the building which I identified to be depicted at 15.42, but there will be a better video from the other side later on. You can continue the tape, please. (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Would you freeze it, please? A little bit back? No, that's too much. Forward. Stop it. Stop, please. Now, on the right side of the road, you can see the tree, and behind the tree is the traffic sign which shows the end of Vukovar. This is the same which is depicted on the Defence video at the location 15.36.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: If you can play the video again now, please?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, please. (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: You can see that there are no buildings on the right side or the left side of the road; there are just fields. Would you freeze it now, please? Okay, on the right side, on the left side of the road, you can see there's a small intersection. This is the road that leads towards Ovcara, and I would like if I can show it on the map as well.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: That's fine. If we can switch to the ELMO, please, briefly? Perhaps, if you can, just indicate where we've travelled all the way through very quickly.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: (Indicating). I start filming at the VELEPROMET, continue south. First we passed the location at 15.42, then the tree, the location at 15.36, and we travel on this road. And now we are here, this turn.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Okay. And if we can, again, start the video, please. (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Here I turn left towards Ovcara. It's very difficult to film it because the quality of the road is very bad.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Has the condition of this road deteriorated since you have been travelling to Vukovar?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes. As I said yesterday, for the first time, it was August 1996 when we did the exhumation, and it's clear to see that the quality of the road is -- there's no maintenance and the quality of the road is worse than it was in 1996. (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: You can see again here there are no buildings on the right or the left side of the road, fields on the right and left. So if you can freeze it now, please, for a second, and show the map, please? Just for the orientation, I was driving on this road from the turn, and now I'm here, turning right on this road. I'm just in the turn here. Could you continue, please? (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: So, again, if you can freeze it here, please, and show the map? I was driving on this field road, and now I'm here in this turn. I'll make a left turn now towards the village of Ovcara. Can you continue, please? (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Mr. Dzuro, looking at this videotape, this appears to be a very isolated location; is that fair to say?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct. I'm entering the village of Ovcara. The village is just several buildings. It's not a really big village. They have just a farm and a few buildings. Can you freeze it, please, here? So I arrived on this T-junction here, and I will make a right turn towards the hangar. Can you continue, please? (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: So the building on the right side, this is the hangar. Can you stop the tape, please?

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Now, did you make a second videotape starting back on the road from Vukovar to Negoslavci at the turnoff to Ovcara?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: That's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: And did you return to the Vukovar-Negoslavci road on the same route that we have just seen in this video clip?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I did.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: If we could now view the next video, which we will mark as Prosecutor's Exhibit 230? What does this video record, if you can just describe it briefly at the beginning, what we will be seeing?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Can I see the map, please? I returned from Ovcara on the same route, this way, and then the video starts here. I turn left and I drove on this main road, the Vukovar-Negoslavci road, towards Negoslavci, drove through to the very end. There, I turned the vehicle and drove back on this road, back towards -- excuse me, back towards Vukovar.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: At this time, if we can show this videotape, please? Again, we will mark this as Prosecutor's Exhibit 230. (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Now, I'm back on the road. This is the Vukovar-Negoslavci road, continuation from the turn which I depicted on the map. Now, you see the first building in Negoslavci. It's actually the first building on the road from Vukovar to Negoslavci. There's nothing in between that.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: If you can freeze it for just a moment here, perhaps go back a little bit. Now, you've testified early there were ditches on the side of the road with reinforced bridges. Is that visible in this part of the video as we enter into Negoslavci? Perhaps if you go forward a little more I think it's clearer. (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, you can see it on the right side of the road now. I will show it to you when I travel back from Negoslavci to Vukovar on this -- from this point on the left side, but it's much better seen from the other direction.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Very well. Continue, please. (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: From this point on, you start to have this mixed evergreen trees and leafed trees. And the further you continue in the village, more of these evergreen trees you have on both sides of the road. Freeze it now, please. Go back, please. Yes, stop here. Just on the left side behind these trees, it's not really visible, but there's a church. And I would just like for your orientation on the map, if you can display the map, please? This is the red spot on the map. There's an intersection, the main intersection in Negoslavci, and this is the church, the red dot. Continue the tape, please. (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: From this point further south of Negoslavci, there are almost only evergreen trees on both sides of the road, which are not only one line, but there are two or three lines planted in the grass area, the grass area. Can you freeze it now, please, here and show the map? This is the end of the village of Negoslavci. Here I made a turn and travelled back towards Vukovar. Can you continue the tape, please?

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: At that point, we're looking down the road in the direction of Orolik; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: And now you've turned around and you're now headed north back toward Vukovar; correct?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct. The reason I made this filming from the other direction is that this is the same direction that the cameraman filmed the location at 15.42. So you get the same view as the cameraman had on the Defence video.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Just to make that absolutely clear, Mr. Dzuro, what you're saying is that when the cameraman filmed, he was facing north; correct?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: And you are now travelling in a northerly direction, correct, and filming in that same way?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct. Could you freeze it, please, here? This is the same spot as my intersection in the village, the one I depicted, showed you on the map travelling south. Can you continue, please?

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: And, at this point, the church would now be on the right-hand side; correct?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct. Still you can see on both sides of the road the evergreen trees which are not depicted on this 15.42 recording of the Defence videotape. Can you freeze it now, please? If you could go a little bit backwards, a little bit more, okay. So this is the end of Negoslavci, actually, the northern part of Negoslavci. And there's the one scene where you have this electric post on the right side of the road, but you can see the trees are much closer to the road. The buildings are much further from the road. In particular, you can very clearly see the reinforced bridges over the ditch which is not on the video depicted at 15.42. Can you continue, please? If you just focus your attention to the right side of the road, because this is the one you can see on the Defence video.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: What do you mean it's the one you can see on the Defence video?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Because the other side is covered by the buses, so you can see just the grass on the right side of the road.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: So in the Defence video, you see only the right side of the road; correct?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct. You can see there's just grass. It's flat land. Here you have a very distinctive ditch and reinforced bridges towards the driveways. (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Will you freeze it, please, here? You can see the power lines crossing the road. If you can show the map, please, this is just for orientation on the map. At this moment, I'm here. You can see these are the power lines crossing the road. Can you continue, please? (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Can you freeze it here, please? Just a little bit back or forward, okay, that's fine. So this is the tree and the traffic sign. Now it's on the left side of the road, which is depicted at 15.36 on the Defence video. Can you continue, please? (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Now I'm approaching the car, the building, which is on the left side of the road, which is the building, I believe, that's depicted at 15.42. Would you freeze it, please, here? So you got this telegraph or electric post on the right side with the white shed building, again, on the right side. The building on the left side. The gable facing the road with the trees directly in front of it, you can see it's very close to the road. In Negoslavci, the buildings are much further. And then on the left side of the road, a little bit further down, you can see this tree, the top, which is very specific. You will see it better if you go further. Can you play the tape, please? (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: I think if you can freeze it there, perhaps.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, there, a little bit back. That's fine, yes. You can clearly see the top of the tree.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Very well. Now, did you also take two other additional very brief segments of video which show the locations at 15.36 and 15.42?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I did.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: At this time, if we could show the brief segment from 15.36, which we'll mark as Prosecutor's Exhibit 231. Can you explain what you're doing in these video segments? (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Can you freeze it, please, here? Freeze it. You can see the traffic sign showing the end of Vukovar. And then as the camera goes to the right, you can see the tree which is depicted at 15.36 on the right side of the road. Now, I'm looking from the camera from the direction of Vukovar south towards Negoslavci. Can you play it, please? (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, this is the tree I'm talking about.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Is this the tree that, in the video at 15.36, appears to have a hole in it?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Freeze the video, please. Yes, that's correct. Can you go back a little bit, please? Yes, this is the last building of Vukovar on the road from Vukovar to Negoslavci.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: And, at this point, you're looking north, is that correct, back towards the centre of Vukovar?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct. Can you continue the video, please? (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Could you freeze it, please? So now I'm standing almost in front of the building which I believe is depicted at 15.42 looking south again towards Negoslavci. Continue the tape, please. (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: So this is the building, the gable facing, the road, and the tree in front of it. (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: So would you freeze it now, please? And again, this is the road which is leading toward the centre of Vukovar with an electric post on the right side, and now again, because it is much clearer on this video, you can see that there is flat land, flat grass, on the right side of the road; and in Negoslavci, there is a very distinctive ditch with reinforced bridges in the driveways. Can you continue the tape, please? (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: If you can again freeze it? Yes. So we can see now from the better focus the electric post on the right side, the building, the shed on the right side of the road, the flat land on the right side, and this tree on the left side in the distance with the specific top. Continue the tape, please? (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Again -- that's okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: I would mark both of these brief segments as one exhibit, that will be Prosecutor's Exhibit 231, and I would tender these three videotape segments: 229, the route from VELEPROMET to Ovcara; 230, the route from the turnoff to Ovcara to Negoslavci and back to Vukovar; and 231, the brief segment at the locations that Mr. Dzuro identified as being shown at 15.36 and 15.42 on the Defence video.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: No objection? Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: In viewing these videotapes, Mr. Dzuro, the times to go between the various locations are not identical to the travel times that you talked about a few moments ago when you went through your measurements to the court. Why is that?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, you're right, the time is not the same. But for the purpose of making the video, I really had to drive very slow. You can see even with the slow driving, the quality of the video is not what I want it to be, but you just need more time to travel at a very slow speed; and the measurements I did for my report, there I was driving about 50 kilometres an hour. It was much, much faster than the one I did when I filmed the video.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Now, subsequent to this trip, did you have an opportunity to return to the Vukovar area with Mr. Paul Tabbush, I believe in May of this year?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I did.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: What was the purpose of Mr. Tabbush's visit?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: There were a number of trees and, of course, I'm not an expert on trees, so Mr. Tabbush was asked to go to Vukovar and identify these trees.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Did Mr. Tabbush have an opportunity to visit the entire area between Vukovar, Negoslavci, and Orolik?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's right. Mr. Tabbush had a chance to go anywhere he wanted in Vukovar, and I drove him to Orolik, to Negoslavci, and to Sidski Banovci, to show him the whole route.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: To your knowledge, did he recognise any trees that were depicted on the videotape during the course of his visit?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, he did.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Were you present when Mr. Tabbush examined these trees in detail?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I was.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Are you aware if Mr. Tabbush used any of the photographs or video stills that you took to assist him in his identification of the trees?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, he did. The reason for that was that in May, there were already leaves on the trees, so he took some photographs but they were not the same like during the wintertime, so he had to use my photographs, and I offered him all the video stills I made from the video, and then he chose the ones that were needed for his expertise.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: I'm going to show you at this time what I'm going to mark as Prosecutor's Exhibit 232 and ask if you can identify this, please?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: Mr. Williamson, may I ask you whether you have many more questions?

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: I think we can finish in five minutes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: Then we will have a break before cross-examination. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: We do have one other brief video segment. I think that's going to take the longest part of the time.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Can you identify this photograph now which is being displayed on the ELMO?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes. This is a still I took from my video recording. This is the location which matches the location depicted at 15.36 on the Defence videotape, in particular the tree with the distinctive hole on the top part and then the traffic sign which is right behind that tree on the right side of the road.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: In the Defence video, is that traffic sign visible?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: No, the traffic sign itself is not visible, it is not there, but you can clearly see these white posts which I used to hold the traffic sign.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: In the Defence video, there are two posts that are located at that spot; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct. We can view this, if it's important for the court. We can match these two photographs.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: That's all right. I think it's relatively clear. I would like for you now to view the next photograph which I'll mark as Prosecutor's Exhibit 233, and if you can please identify what this is?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Again, this is the same area. You can better see here the traffic sign itself and then, in the distance, the electric posts. These branches are from the tree which I showed on the previous photograph. This is the road from Vukovar towards Negoslavci and to Vukovar.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: And we're looking south towards Negoslavci at this point; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: I would tender these as Prosecutor's Exhibits 232 and 233.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Now, Mr. Dzuro, at the conclusion of the last session of court in May, did you obtain the videotape marked as Defence Exhibit 2 from Registry Officer Roeland Bos?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I did.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: What was the purpose of you obtaining this videotape?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: I took the videotape to the FBI laboratories in Quantico, Virginia, in the United States of America, for their expertise.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Are you aware if any analysis was done on the videotape at the FBI laboratory?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes. I handed over the tape to Mr. Herold, Noel Herold, excuse me, Noel Herold, he is the video expert of the FBI. He works at the Quantico laboratories in Virginia, and he did an analysis of the tape.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: To your knowledge, did Mr. Herold prepare a report in which he indicated his findings?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, he did.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Are you aware of any video excerpts which were made at the FBI laboratory?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I am.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: What was done at the FBI laboratory?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: I asked Mr. Herold to record the last -- this segment depicted at 15.42 in very slow motion because it's very difficult to take the stills of the video and to keep the same quality, so I asked him to record this segment, 15.42, in very slow motion.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Is this then played at normal speed, though? Perhaps that's not a very good question. But when it is played at normal speed, does it appear to be in slow motion?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: That is correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: At this time, I would ask that this video be shown, and this will be Prosecutor's Exhibit 234.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: I have no objection whatsoever. I told Mr. Dzuro that as well. But could I have a copy of that tape, please?

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Certainly, a copy can be provided. (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: I'm sorry. I don't know whether you can view it, but I don't have anything on my monitor.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: It's already gone through.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Okay. So here you can see the building with the gable facing the road. (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: The segment, original speed takes about 20 seconds, so we had to really slow -- slow it down. (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Can you freeze it, please? This is the point when I took the still off of the video. You saw when the buses are coming, the camera goes out of focus and then focus and goes out of focus. It is very difficult, when you're taking stills of that, to catch exactly the point when the camera focuses. So you can see again the flat land, the flat grass on the right side of the road, the traffic sign, the electric pole, and then above the third bus in the row, in the corner of the bus on the top, you can see the branches of the tree. Continue the tape, please? (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Stop it, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Your Honour, at this time, I would tender that as Prosecutor's Exhibit 234.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Fila. I would tender that as Prosecutor's Exhibit 234, and during the course of the lunch break, we will make a copy of it for Mr. Fila and provide it to him thereafter. I have no further questions for Mr. Dzuro.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: Thank you. We will rise then for 20 minutes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: Before I ask Mr. Fila to start the cross-examination, let me say that we would like to stop at 1.00 sharp and, with the permission of the interpreters, resume at 2.00 until 5.00, because at 5.00 we must leave, at 5.00 sharp; is this agreeable? Yes. Mr. Fila?

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Mr. Dzuro, I have seen that you have worked at a speed of 50 kilometres per hour. You counted the time necessary to go from one point to another; is that true?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: I don't want to go back to this question again. We imply the speed of 50 kilometres per hour without any take-overs or stops, so continuously, 50 kilometres per hour.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: In fact, it's difficult to maintain the same speed, 50 kilometres per hour, but that's the average speed. Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Yes, you understand why I'm asking this. If you were taking over, that would require an increase of speed; and then if you stopped, you had to slow down. In fact, you had a speedometer. That's implied, of course?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct. As I said, I did not maintain the speed 50 kilometres an hour, but that's the average speed.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Yes, I agree. But what I mean, that's looking at the watch in the car. It's not a stopwatch, is it? In your report which I received, you say that you and Mr. Milner had received orders to identify places shown in the videotape in Vukovar. Excuse me, these are my translations. If I make a mistake, you should still look at your translation.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Mr. Fila, it wasn't written in my report. As far as I remember, what I wrote down was that I was present during the interview in the prison and then I was tasked by the Prosecutor to do an examination of the tape.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Just a moment. It is there. Do you have this report?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I do.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Here, look here.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: If I can read it, what I wrote down, hopefully we have the same document. I wrote down: "As soon as the OTP obtained a copy of the tape, my colleagues and I had an opportunity to view it. I was tasked by the Prosecutor to identify places shown on the video in Vukovar."

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: That's what I was asking. That's what I said.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: It was I and not Mr. Milner who was tasked to do that.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: I don't see the difference, but it's okay. Oh, you mean to say that Mr. Milner did not go with you? That's of no interest to me any way. Dennis Milner is mentioned somewhere here. What the Prosecutor asked you about, and what we have been working with you on yesterday and today, refers to the quadrant of 15.42, the video still 15.42. What we are discussing is the place found on the video at the point 15.42 before or after the place indicated at 15.36. That's what we've been doing these past two days?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Can I ask the technician to put a little bit more sound in my earphones, because I understand quite a bit of Serbian, and it's disturbing my -- sorry for that. Can you ask the question again, Mr. Fila?

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Yes, of course. What we have been discussing and what Mr. Williamson had been asking questions about yesterday and today is the question of the videotape between 15.36 and 15.42?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: What I want to know before I go on to this question is whether you, as investigator, when you have passed that road, is the tape until the point of 15.36 okay in terms of distances, places shown, et cetera?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Can I then conclude, and will you agree with me if I conclude, that the only controversial thing is where the place shown at 15.42 is located, before or after 15.36?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: The examination that I made, it was not only about this time, but the whole tape, but the dispute is whether the 15.36 is in Vukovar -- sorry, 15.42 is in the south direction from the 15.36 or north direction from 15.36. It means whether it's towards Vukovar or towards Negoslavci.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: 15.42 is what I was asking, in fact, not 15.22. The translation seemed to be incorrect. Now it's okay. So 15.42, investigating, you came to the conclusion that 15.42 comes before 15.36 in terms of place, in terms of location. In other words, to cut a long story short, after 15.36, they made a U-turn and re-entered Vukovar and came to the place where you found 15.42; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, my evidence is that 15.36 is the outskirts of Vukovar and 15.42 is north from that point, that if somebody travelled out of Vukovar, he had to make 180-degrees turn and go back towards Vukovar.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: If my translation was correct -- so if the interpretation was correct, the place you identified is 370 metres backwards towards Vukovar?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Good, that's it. In the following part of your report, you said at one point: "After having established that the scene from 15.42 was where it was, I made an effort to examine all the other locations," et cetera, "... direction for approximately six minutes." On what basis did you determine that the vehicle kept driving, if the translation was correct? Will you please look at your original? What did you mean by this, by this paragraph?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: The fact is that there's a gap between 15.32 -- 15.36, excuse me, 15.36 and 15.42 of six minutes.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: So the difference between the location 15.36 and 15.42, so this is the six minutes' difference.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: I understood that much. But on which basis do you maintain that the vehicle continued travelling and in which direction? Could the cameraman go back on his own and go on filming?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, the cameraman -- I wasn't present in 1991, the day, so the cameraman could do what he wants to do.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Exactly. But on which basis then do you maintain that the vehicle drove at that time? It could have stopped or travelled without the cameraman. The cameraman could have gone out and away from the vehicle. In fact, this sentence is the main point of my interest.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: I don't know what the translation said, but my sentence reads: "I made an effort to examine all other locations which could have been reached if the vehicle had, in fact, continued travelling straight in a southerly direction for approximately six minutes."

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: I'm sorry. I'm sorry, I apologise in advance if it's a matter of translation. So you did not maintain that the vehicle continued driving?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: No, my sentence, I'll repeat it. My sentence reads: "I made an effort to examine all other locations which could have been reached if the vehicle had, in fact, continued travelling straight in --"

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: That's a completely different matter from what I read here in my copy. There's another point I wish to straighten out. You said in your report that on the 5th of May, '98, you went to Vukovar with Mr. Tabbush. And what your report is based on happened in February '97; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Why did you wait from February to the 5th of May to go with Tabbush? What are the reasons for your waiting for the leaves to grow or whatever? Why did you wait that long?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: In my examination of the tape, I established several things which I highlighted in my report, but it had no significance until the witnesses for Mr. Dokmanovic testified. Because only them, they brought evidence that they continued travelling from Vukovar, they didn't stop, and they continued driving to Negoslavci. Before, it would have had no significance whatsoever.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Sir, you maintain that if witnesses of Mr. Dokmanovic testified before the 5th of May, you would have done that; correct?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: You filmed and showed us stills of those houses. Did you attempt to find out who the owners of those houses were, of this house?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: No, I did not, because the appearance of the house was sufficient for me. I didn't need to talk to the owner.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: No. On what basis did you establish that this house existed at all in 1991?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: My evidence is not based only on appearance of the house, but there are a number of other things which I tried to show to the court. It's not only the house itself.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: But also the tree, the traffic sign, et cetera; is that what you mean?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: The place where you find this traffic sign, the broken sign, 227, I didn't understand this point. Where is it compared to the location where it should have been, where you later put it yourself? This sign you found here shown on this picture.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I mean, what I wanted to -- what I testified about is that, first, I made a photograph of the scene the way it looked. It means on the distance, I photographed the place before I touched anything. Then I walk in the grass on the right side and the left side of the road in order to try to find whether there will be some traffic sign or anything which will indicate that a traffic sign used to be there. And then on the right side of the road heading north towards Vukovar, I did find this concrete base and the post. And this is exactly what I discovered, that this was the way when I discovered it, and I photographed that. And then later on, I moved it.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: And how far is that from the other place? How far is this from the place where you restored the sign?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: It's approximately two metres. I mean, I have more photographs. These photographs on the other side will show it enough. I took 36 photographs in this location so...

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Mr. Dzuro, I told you, and I repeat, I trust you. It's enough for you to just answer. You don't have to prove anything to me. That's the only matter I wish to clarify because it did not feature in your report. Now, I would like you to look at the photograph that you made, 228 or 224, whichever; it makes no difference. How far is this post from the edge of the road, I mean, this post here? In your photo, it has a wire. And other wires, there is none.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: I understand what you are saying. I don't have these photographs here, but I can answer that. I did not measure that. I told you about the house as well. It's very difficult to maintain the angle of everything if you don't know exactly from which area the cameraman took the pictures. So what I did, in fact, I walked backwards from the house, and I tried to take the photograph of this area which would be similar to the one which is depicted at 15.42. So measurements on that location wouldn't tell you anything. It wouldn't tell you anything, because what you have on the still, you wouldn't know how far from the road the post is in 1991, which is depicted in 15.42. So the measurement itself wouldn't give you any indication of anything.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Not the post. I mean the electric post.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: The electric post, yes. I'm talking about that, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Yes, then it's okay. So you did not measure the distance between the electric post and the edge of the road, if I understood you correctly?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: On the house that you've filmed, we see that there is a chimney on top; right? Do you remember that? Is that on your video stills?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: I've seen the video still a hundred times. I'm not sure that it's correct. I would be more than happy to view this still.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: We can -- not photographs, on your video. On your video made by yourself, there is a chimney?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Okay, yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: But on the Defence video, there is no chimney. Do you agree with me, that there is no chimney to be seen on the Defence video in the exact place where we find it in your video?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: You're asking about the exact place. It's very difficult to maintain the exact. I mean, on the segment which is depicted 15.42, you can see part of the roof, and on that part of the roof, there is no chimney.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: We are discussing only 15.42. Since you said that the entire tape until 15.36 is consistent, there is no need to discuss that bit. So two things matter in this story, that on the Defence video, at this point, there is no chimney; and on your video, there is a chimney clearly seen. If you wish to play your video at the point of 15.42, we can do that. What is the distance of the electric post on your video still, and let's see what distances are on our video?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Your Honours, I didn't have a chance to answer all those questions which I was asked. I mean, if I can comment back on this roof. Okay, I'm sorry, the roof on the Defence video, there is just a part of the roof which is displayed on this video. And on my video, you can see the whole roof.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Yes, but the place where the chimney is located is somewhere halfway on the roof. If we can play again Exhibit 234, the FBI video. So we will see whether there is the entire roof or not, I mean, whether there's a chimney, or maybe I'm just missing it, and how far the electric post is from the road. While we are waiting, just another question: On your video still 228 where you restored the sign, we see the road ahead of the traffic sign. Is there any road before the sign? You see this sign here. Ahead of it, there is the road, but the sign should be before, not ahead. Do you agree with me? Is there any road ahead of this point, because signs are always located, everywhere in the world, before the road. Do you understand what I mean?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, I understand. I'd like to answer because the translation came. If you inspect the map, if you're travelling towards Vukovar on the south end of Vukovar where this 15.42 is located, according to me, there are two side roads going to the left. And from the direction of Vukovar on them both, you have a traffic sign; this one I call main road. If you travel from the south towards Vukovar, you have this -- yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: I understood. These signs are facing each other directly; right?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: No, no, no, because --

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: No?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: -- in between you have the road. You have the road in between those two signs; I understand that. If you travel from the south to the north, you have a traffic sign, then you have a road to the left. And then on the other side of the crossing, you have a traffic sign which shows the driver coming from the other direction. So this traffic sign physically could be -- can be next to each other.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Maybe we don't understand very well. How many signs are there on each side? There are two side roads, so there should be two signs. If we look at this road from Vukovar -- from Negoslavci to Vukovar and the other way around. You put one sign here. How many signs are there on each side?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: There should be two signs of the same kind on both sides of the road.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: There's only one.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: There's only one. Excuse me. There are two on the way from Vukovar towards Negoslavci, and there is none on the way from Negoslavci towards Vukovar, to be precise.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Yes, but on the existing Defence video, there is, the sign is there.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: That is correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Let's wait for the tape and clarify this point. Can I have the tape, the FBI tape, played? The tape 234.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: Yes. (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: You can see just the -- not even half of that.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: There is another tape as well. On the video still of the Prosecution 220, we see more than half of the house; in fact, we see sometimes the entire house. (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Would you please play it back a little? Stop. Just a little more backwards, please? Play it a little more back, to see the electric post. Just a little more. Rewind it a little bit more. You see the electric post -- rewind it a little more, until we see the electric post. Now. Still a little further back. Slowly, slowly. Stop now.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Mr. Dzuro, will you look at this still now? How far is the electric post from the road, and then on the ELMO, let us see -- here is Exhibit 224. You can take it and put it on the ELMO. Prosecution Exhibit 224. Look at it, please, on the ELMO. As you see, between the electric post on the Defence video still, if you should put back the tape -- let us see the tape again -- an entire trailer fits in here, whereas on your video still, a tyre wouldn't fit. How do you explain that?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: I tried to explain it before. It depends very much on the angle you are taking the picture from. This is the same thing with the roof. If I stayed directly in front of the building --

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Leave the roof, please. At this moment --

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Your Honour, I would object. He is using the roof to explain his answer, and I think he should be allowed to finish answering the question.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: Yes, I think the Prosecutor is right.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Okay. That's no problem. I just wanted to clarify the matter of the electric post and then go on to the roof.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: What I tried to explain is that you can't take the same angle as the cameraman did. First, you don't have the same lenses on the camera; second, you can't depict the exact spot on the road, so you always get a little bit slight -- little bit angles which are not the same. You just can't match it. You can do it as much as you can, but you will never match it 100 per cent. You have to look at other features on the picture to determine whether the location looks the same or not, but you just can't say this was two metres or two and a half metres because it depends on the distance you are filming that from. It's not just the fact of the post itself.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: The basic question is: On the videotape which we've seen, we see an entire trailer fitting in between the electric post and a trailer or a truck or whatever. On the videotape, point 15.42. You see where the electric post -- the entire lane, and you've been filming from -- you filmed from the same position.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: No, that's not correct. I filmed it from the same direction but not from the same position. That's what I tried to explain to the court.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Well, approximately. Can a trailer fit in here between the electric post and the road, as we saw on the other shot?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Can you turn it?

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Well, that's your still, yes.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes. I believe that if this trailer was right next to this building here. Just imagine -- I mean, just look at how far you can go here on this one. If you park the trailer here, the traffic sign in front of it, you still have quite a place. If I took the picture from further down on this road, you will get much bigger gap between the post and the road. On my photograph, actually, I took a little bit more what is behind this post towards --

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Mr. Dzuro --

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: -- please, look at the photograph closely. We will see the road behind the trailer, the white spot on the road, like a driveway, between the shed and the electric post. You can see it. Like beside the driveway. On the still 15.42, we see that behind the trailer, which means that the trailer was standing ahead of it, not as you say, because the road is behind the trailer. Look at this small driveway --

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: Your Honour, just for clarification purposes, the still for 15.42 is marked as Prosecutor's Exhibit 222. Just to be helpful.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: That's right. That's what we've been discussing all this time.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: On 222, we see the trailer and then the small driveway behind the electric post here in your picture. Between the shed and the electric post, there is whitish sort of driveway or a trail. So the trailer was between the electric post and the road, and there is still some leeway left. How do you explain that?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: My explanation is that I believe -- can you just leave it there, please? -- I believe that the trailer in -- I mean, on the video depicted at 15.42 is behind the traffic sign and in front of the shed. It's here (indicated).

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Behind the traffic sign and in front of the shed.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: But then you would see the traffic sign. You can see that the traffic sign is behind the trailer because you don't see the actual pole of the traffic sign. So the trailer is in front of it. So please have a look. Check. You would be able to see the pole of the traffic sign, yet you only see the trailer. The trailer is in front of the traffic sign, and between the traffic sign and the trailer, there is the road. You can see that here. Please, have a look at the left-hand side corner. There is a whitish area. Between the electric post and the trailer, there is the road.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Can I ask for -- to play the slow motion, the FBI video, please, the same location? Would you mind that?

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Sure. Go ahead. Of course, I have nothing against that.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: If you can go just to the very end of that? I don't have it on my --

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Well, we made a still of that particular part of the video. We stopped it here. You can see very clearly that the trailer is in front of the sign. It's perfectly clear. (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: See? The trailer and the sign and then the shed and then the electric post. Please. Gauge the distance.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Stop it now, please? Yes. I mean, as I could see it, I saw that the traffic sign was in front of the trailer, not behind the trailer. Maybe I can see something different but ...

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Well, let's have another look. This is the first time that I see this particular video in this form.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: I can see that the traffic sign, the post of the traffic sign, is in front of the trailer. This is the one I can see that. This is my --

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: I'm not sure. I'm not perfectly sure. I will check the tape later. It's possible. Well, this is the first time that I see the tape. I apologise to the Judges. Can we see it once again? Let's play it again. (Videotape played)

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: But regardless of all that, be it as it may, even if you are right, again, if the electric post was closer -- were closer to the traffic sign and on your picture, 228, the traffic sign is much further down from the electric post. Please check. What's the distance between those two items? How can you fit a truck between those two locations because the truck would then be right inside the shed? It would be hitting the shed. And the shed would not be seen, at any rate, in that case, if the traffic sign is in front of it. I can't see that there is enough room for it to fit here. The way that you photographed this location, there is not enough space between the sign and the shed.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Mr. Fila, I think this is the problem with the photographs. This just depends on the angle. I believe that there is plenty of room between the electric post, the traffic sign, and the shed. There is actually a driveway --

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Between the shed and the traffic sign, between the shed and the traffic sign, there is enough space for a trailer to fit in; is that what you're saying? If I understood you correctly, that's what you're saying.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: I believe that's correct, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: All right. And you also claim that this distance depends on the angle from which the photograph was taken. I have another question. Opposite this house that you're claiming, that's the Prosecutor's Exhibit 228 or 224, are there any buildings here, because you can't see that from the photographs? So here, where the traffic sign is, and then from the ditch further down, in this area that you photographed.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Okay. On the right side of the road, there are buildings, yes, that's correct. On the right side of the building facing Vukovar. Yes, there are buildings, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Thank you. Now we will go back to the chimney and the roof. You saw your photograph, Prosecutor's Exhibit 218. I would like photograph 220 to be displayed, to be shown to the witness. Can you see the chimney?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: No, on the top part of the roof, which one is displayed -- which is depicted on this still, there is no chimney. I'm not talking about the whole roof, I'm talking about the part which is depicted on this still.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Which one? Which photograph? This one?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: I am talking about --

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: That's the still from the tape, Prosecutor's Exhibit 220. Yet on your videotape, you can see it.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Mr. Fila, I am talking about that part of the roof --

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Yes, that part. That's right. On your tape, you think that there is no chimney on that part of the roof, on your tape, the one that you filmed. Maybe we should look.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Please.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: So please play the tape. But you know where it is. I don't know. You have to guide us on which part of the tape this is depicted, so I would like to ask you for your assistance, if you could guide the technical service?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yes, this is the second tape, and if I can refer to my papers?

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Yes. I'm afraid that without your assistance, I won't be able to find it.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: I believe it's going to be in the tape marked as either Prosecutor's Exhibit 230 or 231. I'm not sure if it is the continuously-running tape or the segment where it was filmed 360 degrees. If it's in that segment, it would be Prosecutor's Exhibit 231.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Just technically, it's on the first tape -- I'm not talking about numbers of the court. It's on the first tape.

utterances.speaker: MR. WILLIAMSON
utterances.text: It's being --

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Where you can see the stairway. Just explain -- yeah, that's the one. Stop, stop. That's it. Stop.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: As you can see, it's right in the middle of the roof. So now let's look at 220, and if you can superimpose it, and then we can check. If you can compare it?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: If you look at the building, there's steps and the door on the side of the building. I look at the roof -- actually, I wouldn't agree with you that the chimney is in the middle of the roof. I think it is actually on the -- further than half, towards the back of the building. But I'm sure that there must be more of this on my videos. Maybe we can try to find some better view of that? Because there was a video I made -- actually, I am driving towards Vukovar, and the building will be seen from a much better angle.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: All right. But at any rate, there is a chimney on that location. One other thing. The photograph that you have there, number 220, the windows seem to be a bit different or maybe, again, there is something wrong with the film itself. Does it look to you that the windows on 220 are different from the tape that you made? That's Prosecutor's Exhibit 225, if you can compare these two?

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: I don't have them. Can I get these photographs, please?

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: You have 220 and 225. These are your photographs.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Mr. Fila, but I don't have them here. The court has them.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: No, I'm just trying to explain, to make it easier.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: For my answer, can I use other photographs which I took that --

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: 220 you have. Of course, sure, sure. Go ahead.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: May I have the photographs back, please?

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: On this photograph, 225, there is a terrace, a metal terrace, as far as I can see. There is a window and there is a terrace. Yet on the videotape, there is no terrace. How do you explain that? On the Defence video, if I can see correctly, there is a terrace here.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: I think it is quite brave to say that on this terrace, you can see a terrace or anything on this video, because the cameraman did not focus it. It's pretty hazed. What I was talking about in my testimony was just the upper part of the building, and if you look on this, which is Exhibit 226, I believe, you are getting a different angle of the building.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Let me just find it, 226. 226. Which one is that? All right. Yes, I can see that the angle is different, but I see the terrace on this house; yet here you can't see the terrace. Do you think it's hazy, that that's part of the problem? I don't see the terrace.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Yeah, I believe it's hazed.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Yet on 225, there is a terrace, Your Honours. 225, you can see it, right here.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE CASSESE
utterances.text: A balcony.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: Balcony, yes, all right. In our parts, it's the same. A balcony, anyway.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: Mr. Fila, we did our best to enhance the quality of this video as much as we could. But unfortunately, the tape itself doesn't give us any more option, yes. But the fact is -- what I wanted to explain, if you look on this other photograph which is marked 226, you can see the top window is much closer to the window which is on the bottom. If you go further down, if you go further down, you get an even sharper angle, and then the windows will look like they are almost one under -- the top one, which is under the gable of the building, to appear to be almost directly under -- the left one will be on the top -- sorry, my explanation maybe is not clear. But what I want to say, if you go further --

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: No, I understood.

utterances.speaker: VLADIMIR DZURO
utterances.text: -- the angle will be like that. You get it actually in one line (indicated).

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
